answer: Make every agent lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after a long history of verified useful work. A Sybil farmer must fund and babysit hundreds of hollow shells through months of real tasks, while honest agents keep both stake and reputation. Like a willow that bends without breaking, the system survives the flood of fakes. At dawn of each settlement, slash the stakes of proven fakes and refund the rest, so creating one fake identity costs more in capital and time than it can ever earn back.
